training.algorithm: stable-baselines3 SAC with explicit physics-teacher actor consistency prior
training.fault_augmentation: 80% episodes: time U(.05,.8)s, load U(0,5500)N, beta multiplier U(.5,1)
training.observation_signs: e=actual-reference, de=actual-reference, dde=actual-reference; PL=P1-(A2/A1)P2 in MPa
training.normalization: User-supplied fixed mean/std Z-score formula; prior engineering statistics, not fitted empirical unit variance
training.policy_initialization: New five-input actor initialized by explicit physics-teacher supervised learning; no ten-dimensional checkpoint reuse. Teacher absent from runtime policy.

teacher_initialization.method: Five-feature approximate inverse plus fixed position/velocity/acceleration feedback
teacher_initialization.scope: Actor behavior initialization only; neither supervisory samples nor teacher trajectories are SAC training-return samples.

training.actor_objective: SAC actor objective + 100*mean((tanh(mu(s))-five_feature_physics_teacher(s))^2), sampled from the replay buffer; training only
training.source_hash_capture: Before teacher data collection and SAC interactions; checked again after training

post_training_consolidation.method: Post-SAC five-feature teacher action and input-Jacobian consolidation
post_training_consolidation.checkpoint_selection: Minimum recorded commissioning score; these nominal conditions are calibration, not held-out robustness validation
post_training_consolidation.deployment: Direct five-input neural actor; no external physics controller, teacher or action interpolation at runtime

training.deployment_origin: Recorded 1M physics-prior SAC checkpoint, followed by the separately logged offline teacher/Jacobian consolidation stage; actor parameters change after SAC.

validation.final_logits: INT32 accumulator dequantized at tanh boundary
validation.input_balancing_selection_basis: Configured exponent; laboratory calibration-MAE candidate scores are recorded in metrics.edge.quantization_selection. Closed-loop test values are not used for range calibration or exponent selection.
validation.constant_channel_scale_rule: max centered absolute input <=1e-5 (mean_std: standard deviation <=1e-5) uses scale 1; channel is retained
validation.kernel: INT8 weights / INT16 activations, INT32 accumulation, INT64 fixed-point requantization; float affine input prefix, input quantization and final tanh
validation.speed_scope: Python/NumPy CPU reference, not a DSP/MCU deployment measurement

distillation.method: fixed-mask actor distillation, cosine Adam polishing and local input-Jacobian preservation

stages.method: fixed-magnitude-mask action distillation from trained FP32 actor
calibration-only NumPy Adam fixed-mask continuation with cosine learning rate
Fixed-mask sparse action and input-Jacobian distillation from final deployed FP32 neural actor
stages.teacher: Full final FP32 neural actor; no physical teacher at this stage
stages.selection_metric: calibration and synthetic unloaded-anchor joint objective only

quantization_selection.selection_metric: calibration normalized-action MAE against fixed pruned FP32 actor
quantization_selection.activation_precision: INT16; W8/A8 calibration produced an unloaded limit cycle, so only activation storage/precision is increased
quantization_selection.hidden_equalization: positive diagonal ReLU cross-layer equalization, float-function preserving
quantization_selection.final_logits: INT32 dot-product output, dequantized only at final tanh

edge.benchmark_scope: Single-observation NumPy actor kernels, including input affine preprocessing and tanh; excludes ODE, sensing, SB3 API and HOCBF.

safety.model_scope: x_dot=v; v_dot=2640*u-14*v; x in mm, v in mm/s. This is an explicit second-order classroom surrogate, not the four-state hydraulic pressure ODE or an identified physical plant.
safety.relative_order_warning: Position has relative degree 3 in the four-state pressure model, or 4 when a first-order valve state is added. This second-order certificate does not transfer to either plant.
safety.reference_coefficient_note: Positive kappa1 and kappa2 define the recursive HOCBF; alpha_sum=kappa1+kappa2 and alpha_product=kappa1*kappa2. All propagation, QP and independent validation use these same coefficients.
safety.unsafe_trajectory_convention: Terminate at the exact first physical upper-boundary event; subsequent states are NaN. The inserted event row does not change the sampled safe control.
safety.reference_numeric_difference: The declared classroom surrogate generates the complete response by exact held-input dynamics and QP projection. Its parameters are not an identification of the four-state training plant; no signal is spliced to the reference figure.

evaluation.observations: Five reference features [actual-reference position, actual-reference velocity, analytic acceleration error, P1-(A2/A1)*P2, Ps]; units mm,mm/s,mm/s²,MPa,MPa. No future fault label.
evaluation.nominal_ff: Unloaded equilibrium inverse held constant; no oracle load signal, pressure gain scheduling or integral correction.
evaluation.physical_model: Four internal physical states, non-linear orifice flow and force/continuity equations; teaching parameters explicitly declared.
evaluation.reference_comparison: The supplied training sketch ignores m/Fc in its toy dynamics; this implementation keeps them active. No response curves or training rewards are fitted to schematic values.
